_help: Act 9, Level 2, the underground chambers: a sealed way and hostile spirits. Clues from Acts 4 and 5 open it safely; otherwise force it and fight (event act9_halls_fight). Generated by tools/dialogue/make_act89.py.

start.speaker: noura
start.line: The way down is sealed again, and the air is full of voices.

choices.label: Open it the old way
choices.line: The hieroglyph wall told us how: press, don't force.

choices.label: Use the scarab mechanism
choices.line: Behind the scarab wall there's a catch. Here.

choices.label: Take the storeroom route
choices.line: The sealed storeroom runs under all of this. We go round.

choices.label: Read the souls inscription
choices.line: The Hall of Souls inscription: name them, and they must go.

choices.label: Align the stars
choices.line: The astronomer's platform: the mechanism turns to the stars. Like this.

o_0.speaker: noura
o_0.line: It opens without a sound. You did read the walls.

o_1.speaker: noura
o_1.line: A passage behind the wall. Clever, clever builders.

o_2.speaker: noura
o_2.line: Round, and away from the voices. Yes.

o_3.speaker: noura
o_3.line: The voices are fading. Keep saying it. Keep saying it!

o_4.speaker: noura
o_4.line: The stones move. The way is open.

fight.speaker: omar
fight.line: Then they come for us. Weapons!
